summary: Cycurion, Inc. (Parent) filed an 8-K to report its entry into a merger agreement to acquire Halo Privacy, Inc. and havenX, Inc. through two separate merger subsidiaries. The aggregate consideration comprises cash, stock, and contingent/deferred payments including earnouts. At closing, Parent will pay $1.0 million in cash consideration. The mergers are structured as reverse triangular mergers with each target surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. The board's recommendation and advisors are not named. The deal is subject to customary closing conditions and post-closing true-ups. Investors should watch for regulatory clearance and the earnout milestones to gauge total deal value.
